captions.detailed: A minimalist, compact desktop all-in-one printer in a light gray finish. It features a main cubic body with rounded edges, a flat scanner lid on top, and a flat rear paper feeder extending from the back edge. On the front panel, there is a dark gray slide-out paper tray at the bottom, a small rotating selector knob, and two small push-button controls.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a minimalist all-in-one desktop printer in CadQuery. The model should feature a main cubic body with rounded corners, a flat scanner lid hinged at the rear, a slide-out front paper tray, a rear feeder tray, a rotatable dial knob, and two push buttons on the front interface.
captions.factory: The printer is constructed using CadQuery solid modeling. The main body begins as a box with filleted edges, which is hollowed out or cut to form the interior cavities. The scanner lid and rear paper feeder are modeled as flat boxes with rounded corners, positioned with rotational joints at their hinge axes. The front paper tray is a flat rectangular slide-out component with a prismatic joint. The control interface on the front panel is assembled by creating small cylinder primitives for the rotating dial knob (continuous joint) and the two push buttons (prismatic joints).
